title: Constraint_Error when turn crosses north
prompt: Nav.Turn raises Constraint_Error when the turn crosses north, e.g. Turn (From => 350, To => 10) should return 20 (clockwise degrees) but crashes. Fix Nav.Turn in nav.adb so it always returns the clockwise turn in 0 .. 359, and add the 350 -> 10 case to test_nav.adb.
